notes: Real disc scanned on joe with Tools/capture-disc.sh (2026-09-16) while the user had it in the drive; the first live use of the script and the run that found four bugs in it (fixed in this same pass -- negative MainFeature was copied through as outcomeIndex instead of being treated as none, handbrakeVersion came from a HandBrakeCLI --version banner line instead of scan.json's own Version block, and lsdvd's failure to produce a discId was a silent null instead of a diagnosed one -- see Tools/capture-disc.sh's own comments). HandBrake reports MainFeature: -1 on this disc -- it identifies NO main feature at all. #0056: DiscTitleHeuristic.classify now treats that (absent/<=0/unknown-index) as 'the scanner gave no answer' and falls back to the 45-minute length threshold; title 11 (2:26:53, 16 chapters) is the only title on the disc at or above 45 minutes (titles 1-3 run 8-10 minutes, everything else under two), so it is promoted to .single by length, and the Play All guard (run on the fallback candidate exactly as on a scanner-provided one) does not fire -- titles 1-3 do cluster within 15% of each other but their 1,597 s sum misses title 11's 8,813 s by far more than the 2% tolerance. Every audio stream on every title is untagged (languageCode nil) -- this is the disc #0027's 'never merge untagged tracks' rule was written for; AudioTrackOptionsTests.realHornetsNestFeatureTitleKeepsBothUntaggedAudioTracksSeparate pins title 11's shape directly (duration, chapters, isUntagged, and AudioTrackOptions.options(for:).count == 2), and DiscTitleHeuristicTests.classifiesTheRealHornetsNestCaptureAsASingleFeatureByLength pins the classify outcome including FeatureSource.length. subtitleGroupCount (1) and audioTrackCount (2) below were independently re-derived the same way #0055 derived the other three discs' expectations: compiling HandBrakeScanParser/DiscInfo/LanguageCode/SubtitleGrouping/AudioTrackOptions standalone with swiftc and running them directly against this scan.json.
